label: class_f_04_dragon_01
text: I do hope you’re all ready, because it is time for\nyour midterm exam! Focus and do your best![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_04_question_01
text:
1. What is the name of the gemstone that glows
    over a Pokémon’s head when it Terastallizes?

A) Tera Jewel
B) Tera Rock
C) Tera Stone

label: class_f_04_question_02
text:
2. When the answer to question 1 is in the shape
    of flowers, what type does it represent?

A) The Grass type
B) The Fire type
C) The Water type

label: class_f_04_question_03
text:
3. What shape are most snowflakes
    classified as?

A) Square
B) Hexagon
C) Octagon

label: class_f_04_question_04
text:
4. Where is the eatery that allows you to
    change a Tera Type?

A) Cabo Poco
B) Levincia
C) Medali

label: class_f_04_question_05
text:
5. What makes something beautiful?

A) Its shape and color
B) The eye of the beholder
C) I don’t know
D) There’s no correct answer

label: class_f_04_ansewer_05b
text: B) The eye of the beholder

label: class_f_04_dragon_03
text: Time’s up! That’s it for today’s test.\nPencils down, please.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_04_dragon_04
text: I would rather not have students worry about\npassing or failing in my art class, but tests are\r\ntests, after all...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_04_dragon_05
text: Anyway, good work, everyone! You can check\nyour results at the front desk.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
